thread:
marta: Heads-up — noticed a regression after pulling the latest flashattention variant (fa-v2-optimized) from upstream. P95 for seq=1024 spiked on paged-attn runs.
li: :eyes: which upstream commit? fa repo or the vendor drop?
marta: fa@b6f2a1 (merge that changed the kernel tiling heuristic). Also vLLM bumped to 0.6.1 in the test runner which pulls a different KV layout.
omar: can you paste the perf numbers?
marta: baseline (our pinned fa v1.9): p95=38ms, throughput=128 tok/s. after fa@b6f2a1 + vLLM0.6.1: p95=62ms, throughput=105 tok/s. saw ~+40% CPU on host and 18% throughput drop.
raj: yikes. KV cache behavior changed?
marta: yeah, noticed more KV churn. Memory scanning shows repeated cache evicts on long-chat flows. suspect the new kernel touches KV layout differently causing more memcpy.
devon: any repro commands? would like to run locally.
marta: repro script:
```
# run benchmark
./bench_runner --model llama-2-13b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --planner paged --kernel flash --reps 50
```
and baseline pinned with `git checkout v1.9` in fa submodule.
li: I ran a quick flamegraph. The hot path is in `flash_attention::run` -> memcpy -> `kv_table::reindex`.
kernel-bot: CI: fa-integration/job/9213 finished — tests: 342 passed, 3 flaky, 1 perf-regression detected
build-bot: build fa@b6f2a1 + vllm0.6.1, docker image pushed: redwood/fa-test:2026-03-10
omar: can we roll a compatibility shim to keep old KV layout until upstream stabilizes?
raj: alternative: change kernel selection order to prefer fused-attn fallback for seq>512 until we verify.
li: quick mitigation: tweak batching heuristic to reduce batch packing for long seq to avoid KV pressure. In practice set `max_batch_latency_ms=8` -> reduces p95 but hurts throughput slightly.
devo n: (typo) — devon: i benchmarked that tweak: p95 drops to ~48ms, throughput 118 tok/s. still not baseline but acceptable as a short-term mitigation.
marta: good. I'll open an upstream issue against FA (link: https://github.com/flash-attn/flash-attn/issues/481) with profile and minimal repro.
li: also file a patch to vLLM to avoid the new KV compaction when using our paged planner — they changed a default arg.
omar: we should add unit to rollout policy: if model.P95 increases >20% on smoke tests, block auto-upgrade.
raj: agree. I'll add a circuit-breaker in routing (prefer fallback kernels) and add an alert in Console: per-route kernel-regression.
kernel-bot: perf-monitor: reg check triggered on route llm-chat/pgd — delta p95 +42% since last deploy
marta: action items:
- marta: open FA issue + repro + flamegraph
- li: PR to vLLM pin + optional flag to disable KV compaction
- raj: add kernel-order override + rollout guard
- devon: run extended regression suite on dedicated cluster and collect flamegraphs (seq 256/512/1024)
- omar: prepare rollback plan for fa v1.9 pin in platform images
li: timeline? we'd like short patch to vLLM and the kernel-order change today, extended tests tomorrow.
marta: agreed. starting the issue and attaching logs. will annotate with `@eng-runtime`.
li: thanks — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
build-bot: NOTE: rollback images available: redwood/fa-test:v1.9, redwood/fa-test:v1.8
marta: ping when smoke passes or if any extra regressions show up. thanks everyone."
